summary: Flathead National Forest 20-foot pole tower with L-4 cab, built 1933, abandoned by the 1970s and fell under snow in 1998. No source describes the site today.

facts.design: 20-foot pole tower with L-4 cab (built 1933); earlier two-story 14x14-foot cab (1923) with a later cupola
facts.status_note: Fell down under heavy snow in 1998. No source describes what remains.

access.note: No source says whether the ridge is open to visitors.

notes_for_editor: All dates, the 1998 collapse and the 1956-58 personnel come from one firelookout.com page. The oral history gives no years. The page gives a 1923 cab and a 1933 tower without saying how they relate; the story reports both as the page does. Height is the 20-foot tower only, converted to 6.1 m. No Forest Service record was found. The brief record had no dates, so nothing to correct.
